HTML Entity MC Context Purpose entity-mc is the standard bootstrap skill for deploying Entity Mission Control helper tooling to crew agents without manual script copying. It packages the working Mission Control helper runtime into one reusable, versioned bundle with a thin installer layer and per-agent manifests. Why it exists Previous deployments relied on copying scripts by hand into agent homes, especially on Mac-hosted agents like Zora. That worked, but created drift risk, weak rollback, and awkward onboarding. entity-mc is the replacement direction: one canonical runtime one thin bootstrap/install skill tiny per-agent manifests idempotent install/update verification and rollback built in Architecture Shared runtime bundle Canonical scripts packaged from skills/entity-mc/source-scripts/: mc.sh mc-auto-pull.sh mc-assign-model.sh mc-build-context.sh mc-stall-check.sh Note: source-scripts/ is the safe staging source (not workspace scripts/ which may contain wrapper stubs after install). Skill files Located at: skills/entity-mc/SKILL.md skills/entity-mc/VERSION skills/entity-mc/lib.sh skills/entity-mc/install.sh skills/entity-mc/verify.sh skills/entity-mc/rollback.sh Manifest model Per-agent manifests live under: skills/entity-mc/manifests/ Current manifests: ada.env scotty.env spock.env book.env zora.env Manifest fields include: agent name target home target scripts dir state dir install mode (copy or symlink) cron enable flags cron cadence profile name extra notes Install behavior Install stages a versioned release under the target agent state dir, updates a current pointer, then installs wrappers or symlinks into the target scripts/ directory. State layout under the target home: .entity-mc/releases/<version>/ .entity-mc/runtime/ .entity-mc/current .entity-mc/current-version .entity-mc/previous-release-path Cron behavior Cron is managed only inside a tagged marker block: # BEGIN ENTITY_MC:<AgentName> # END ENTITY_MC:<AgentName> Current schedules: auto-pull: every 10 minutes stall-check: every 2 hours Safety property: reruns replace only the managed block instead of appending duplicate cron lines Verification and rollback Verify verify.sh checks: state dir exists runtime dir exists current version matches packaged scripts are present and executable wrappers/symlinks exist in target scripts dir cron marker block exists exactly once when cron install is enabled Rollback rollback.sh restores the previous release recorded in: .entity-mc/previous-release-path Rollout strategy Council-backed rollout order: Scotty Spock Book Canary first, then widen. Prior working deployment context Zora’s manual deployment was the source bundle to extract from.
